description_en: Adds an instance whitelist. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
description_zh:
增加实例白名单
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例
name: AddInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID for which to create the IP/VPC whitelist
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The whitelist IP or VPC ID. IP addresses are specified in CIDR block format
parameters.help_zh: 白名单IP或vpcId，IP以网段的形式设置
parameters.name: white_list_item

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist type.

WhiteListType set to 1: IP whitelist type.

WhiteListType set to 2: VPC ID whitelist type.

The VPC whitelist applies only to instances whose VPC access point is of the anytunnel type. The VPC access point of the latest version instances is of the privateLink type. You cannot set a VPC whitelist for privateLink instances
parameters.help_zh:
白名单类型。

WhiteListType为1，IP白名单类型；

WhiteListType为2，VPCID白名单类型；

vpc白名单仅针对vpc接入点是anytunnel类型的实例。最新版本实例vpc接入点为privateLink类型，不能针对privateLink设置vpc白名单
parameters.name: white_list_type

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success

StatusCode.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success
StatusCode.description_zh: 调用返回码，200标识为成功
